description: Maps a set of controller button bits to an inline input-guide icon in each of the gamepad device decorators.

InputKey.simple: Controller button bits matched by the row.
InputKey.technical: The row defaults to EInputKey::None. For an EGameInputKey tag, the decorator reads the current game-key button bits and compares them with static_cast<uint32>(InputKey). It selects the first exact match encountered in row-map iteration.

Brush.technical: SelectBySize returns this brush for Normal after a row matches the current button bits.

SmallBrush.technical: SelectBySize returns this brush for Small after a row matches the current button bits.

TinyBrush.technical: SelectBySize returns this brush for Tiny after a row matches the current button bits.

usages.detail: Obtains the device decorator's CustomImageSet. A null table stops lookup.
Routes XInput, DualShock, DualSense, Switch Pro Controller, and Joy-Con to this row schema and returns null for a missing button match.
Tags outside EGameInputKey use the fallback input-guide parameter path.

notes: The gamepad decorators each expose a CustomImageSet UDataTable pointer. The available dataset has no matching variant export.
The lookup compares the InputKey property while iterating the row map. Unreal row names do not select the gamepad icon.
